MERISE-E001.title: Unnamed entity
MERISE-E001.explanation: Give each entity a business name.

MERISE-E002.title: Entity without identifier
MERISE-E002.explanation: Add at least one identifying property per entity.

MERISE-E003.title: Unnamed attribute
MERISE-E003.explanation: Every property must have a name.

MERISE-E004.title: Duplicate attribute
MERISE-E004.explanation: Two properties cannot share the same name within one object.

MERISE-E005.title: Invalid identifier
MERISE-E005.explanation: An identifier must reference existing properties, without duplicates.

MERISE-E006.title: Unnamed association
MERISE-E006.explanation: Name the association with a business verb.

MERISE-E009.title: Association with incomplete cardinalities
MERISE-E009.explanation: Set a cardinality at each end.

MERISE-E010.title: Reference to deleted entity
MERISE-E010.explanation: Remove or rewire links to missing objects.

MERISE-E012.title: Duplicate physical name
MERISE-E012.explanation: Distinguish names that become identical in SQL.

MERISE-E020.title: Inheritance without valid parent
MERISE-E020.explanation: Point to an existing parent entity, distinct from its children.

MERISE-E021.title: Inheritance — invalid child
MERISE-E021.explanation: Each child must be an existing entity, without duplicates.

MERISE-E022.title: Inheritance cycle
MERISE-E022.explanation: Inheritance must not form a loop.

MERISE-E023.title: Constraint — invalid reference
MERISE-E023.explanation: The constraint must only target objects present in the diagram.

MERISE-E025.title: FD — invalid entities
MERISE-E025.explanation: A functional dependency links two distinct, existing entities.

MERISE-E026.title: FD — missing functional dependency
MERISE-E026.explanation: First link the entities with an association where max cardinality is 1 on the target side.

MERISE-E027.title: Incomplete business rule
MERISE-E027.explanation: Fill in the business rule name and description.

MERISE-E028.title: Business rule — invalid reference
MERISE-E028.explanation: The business rule must only target objects present in the diagram.

MERISE-BR001.title: Business rule
MERISE-BR001.explanation: Business rule documented on the model.

MERISE-W001.title: Unclear name
MERISE-W001.explanation: Prefer a clear business name: uppercase for entities, verb for associations.

MERISE-W002.title: Potentially non-atomic attribute
MERISE-W002.explanation: An attribute should contain only one piece of information.

MERISE-W003.title: Suspicious repetitive structure
MERISE-W003.explanation: Suffixes _1, _2… suggest a separate entity instead.

MERISE-W004.title: Suspicious functional dependency
MERISE-W004.explanation: This property seems to depend on something other than the identifier.

MERISE-W005.title: Ternary or higher-order association
MERISE-W005.explanation: Split into an intermediate entity and binary associations.

MERISE-W016.title: Potentially unstable identifier
MERISE-W016.explanation: Prefer a stable technical key over a name, email or address.

MERISE-W017.title: Plural entity name
MERISE-W017.explanation: In MERISE, an entity is named in the singular (CLIENT, not CLIENTS).

MERISE-W019.title: Entity without descriptive property
MERISE-W019.explanation: Add business properties beyond the identifier.

MERISE-W020.title: Redundancy between linked entities
MERISE-W020.explanation: Avoid duplicating a property already carried by a linked entity.

MERISE-W022.title: 1,1 relationship on both sides
MERISE-W022.explanation: Check whether the two entities should merge or use a foreign key.

MERISE-W025.title: Boolean identifier
MERISE-W025.explanation: A boolean only distinguishes two occurrences.

MERISE-E013.title: Empty or duplicate internal ID
MERISE-E013.explanation: Every object must have a unique technical identifier.

MERISE-E015.title: Nullable identifying property
MERISE-E015.explanation: An identifier component cannot be nullable.

MERISE-E016.title: Invalid type configuration
MERISE-E016.explanation: Fix the detailed type configuration in the form.

MERISE-E017.title: Inconsistent type family
MERISE-E017.explanation: Re-select the type to resync the summary and configuration.

MERISE-E018.title: SQL column collision
MERISE-E018.explanation: Rename properties that produce the same SQL column.

MERISE-E019.title: Invalid SQL reference
MERISE-E019.explanation: Check identifiers and types of referenced keys.

MERISE-W006.title: Redundant or non-minimal identifier
MERISE-W006.explanation: Keep minimal identifiers without repeating an already unique key.

MERISE-W007.title: Ambiguous reflexive roles
MERISE-W007.explanation: Name the roles in a reflexive association.

MERISE-W008.title: Potentially duplicate association
MERISE-W008.explanation: Check whether this link is truly distinct from an identical one.

MERISE-W009.title: Foreign key possibly entered in CDM
MERISE-W009.explanation: Model the link with an association; the FK appears in the LDM.

MERISE-W010.title: Potentially redundant calculated data
MERISE-W010.explanation: A calculable property does not belong in the CDM, except as a historical snapshot.

MERISE-W011.title: Association property dependencies to review
MERISE-W011.explanation: Check whether these properties describe the entity or the link.

MERISE-W012.title: Key based on floating-point number
MERISE-W012.explanation: Avoid floats in a key or identifier.

MERISE-W013.title: Domain partially translated to SQL
MERISE-W013.explanation: Generated SQL does not enforce the entire chosen domain.

MERISE-W014.title: Collection in a property
MERISE-W014.explanation: An array may hide a related entity to model separately.

MERISE-W015.title: Required property on optional link
MERISE-W015.explanation: NOT NULL on the link may become mandatory even without an occurrence.

MERISE-I001.title: Composite key dependencies to document
MERISE-I001.explanation: Manually verify 2NF and 3NF for this composite key.

MERISE-I002.title: Minimum participation not guaranteed by SQL
MERISE-I002.explanation: SQL alone does not guarantee a mandatory business-side link.

MERISE-I003.title: Custom type to verify on server
MERISE-I003.explanation: Confirm this PostgreSQL type exists on the target server.

MERISE-I004.title: Isolated entity
MERISE-I004.explanation: This entity is not linked to any association in the diagram.
